channel.title: hack_journal // devlog
channel.description: Deep-dives into systems engineering, performance metrics, and building in public.

item.title: Compiling in the Cold: The Art of Sub-Millisecond Server Actions
item.description: Client bundles are treated as landfill space. We bypass Next.js cold boots using a custom Go worker, connection ping, and Docker swarms.

item.title: Taming the Pool: Optimizing Edge Database Connection Overhead
item.description: Database connections on serverless platforms are notoriously transient. Learn how to establish a TCP multiplexer proxy for fast handshakes.

item.title: Bypassing Kubernetes: Simple Swarm-Based Deployments for Solopreneurs
item.description: Kubernetes introduces massive configuration fatigue. Docker Swarm offers a built-in orchestration layer that requires no external setup.
